title: USB photo screensaver
info:
Choose a USB folder with the remote. Photos repeat every 30 seconds.
Automatic timing: 5 minutes idle, 25 minutes of photos, sleep at minute 30.
no_drive: No readable USB drive is connected. Connect it and try again.
read_only: Photos are read only. No file is changed, copied or deleted.
folder_only: Only images directly in this folder
no_images: No readable photos. Connect the drive or choose another folder.
navigation: ↑ ↓ Select   OK Open / confirm   BACK Previous screen   HOME TV menu
folder_navigation: ↑ ↓ Select   OK Open / use folder   ← / BACK Parent folder
preview_controls: ← / → Photo   OK Pause / resume   BACK Close
storage_changed: USB changed. Choose an available drive.
